task: Materialize and bind an executor-owned parent closure proof artifact so the derived closure plan has a real canonical projection and implementation target without falsifying runtime edits or weakening Plan/Edit-Time gates.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Release Unit Execution #296 proves the derived parent closure plan successfully removed the historical DEV_PLAN_UNPLANNED_FILE problem, but its own planned projection is empty because it contains only quality/development/active-plan.json, which Plan Before Code intentionally excludes as self-referential development metadata. Critical Operational Intelligence also requires a real execution route target, so an empty mustEdit/mustCreate closure route is invalid. The fix must not invent a runtime edit or bypass the gate. Parent closure needs a deterministic executor-owned proof artifact under canonical quality knowledge authority, created and validated during final-main proof and persisted with the closure PR.
observableOutcomes: Every parent closure proof derives a deterministic artifact path quality/knowledge/release-parent-closure-proofs/<parent-slug>.json.

The proof artifact contract binds parentTransactionId, sourceCommit, sourcePlanDigest, completionContractDigest, exact finalMainSha, ordered unit close receipt digests, trustedMainAdvanceDigest and derived closure-plan context digest.
The derived closure plan projects both quality/development/active-plan.json and the exact proof-artifact path, with the proof artifact declared as mustCreate and proof evidence.

Critical Operational Intelligence recognizes mustCreate as a valid route target only for a valid parentClosureContext contract, analogous to the existing release-unit child transaction rule; normal critical plans still require mustEdit.

Plan Before Code naturally derives DOMAIN-QUALITY / quality-knowledge-system and the canonical full failure corpus from the quality/knowledge proof artifact while the release-oriented task preserves the release-infrastructure subsystem.
runParentProof writes the exact proof artifact into the temporary final-main worktree before Plan/Edit-Time and passes its path through a dedicated parent-closure proof environment variable.

Edit-Time validates the parent proof artifact contract, path, context digest, final-main identity and file bytes before treating the declared parent closure mustCreate obligation as fulfilled; missing, forged or stale artifacts remain BLOCK.
createClosurePullRequest stages and persists both the emitted closed active-plan and the exact parent closure proof artifact in the same executor-owned closure commit.
recordReleaseParentClosureWithProofContext validates the artifact/context digest again and stores artifact path/digest in the parent close receipt.
PR-head CI sees the real proof artifact creation plus active-plan metadata closure and proves the exact closure transaction without runtime-code fabrication.
PR_OPEN safe-main reprojection creates a fresh proof artifact bound to the newer final main and requires fresh exact CI before merge.
unresolvedRisks: Globally allowing mustCreate as a critical route target would weaken non-child planning semantics.
Treating file existence alone as proof could accept a stale or forged closure artifact.
The artifact path must be deterministic per parent transaction or interrupted retries could create duplicates.
The artifact content must not contain credentials, environment secrets or mutable timestamps that make replay nondeterministic.
If createClosurePullRequest forgets to stage the proof artifact, final parent receipt would reference evidence not persisted in repository history.
If the proof artifact changes after Truth but before commit, the persisted receipt could diverge from what was verified.
A safe main reprojection must replace the same deterministic artifact path with new bound content instead of generating parallel receipts.
The source completionContract and immutable source plan must remain unchanged.

in: Introduce a versioned parent closure proof artifact contract and deterministic path/content builder in release-unit runtime.
Add proofArtifactPath and proofArtifactDigest to parentClosureContext and derived plan validation.
Project the exact proof artifact path alongside active-plan metadata in the derived parent closure plan.
Allow parent-closure-context critical routes to use mustCreate as the required route target without changing generic critical planning rules.
Add a narrowly-scoped Edit-Time parent closure proof artifact validator keyed by SHOPERATION_PARENT_CLOSURE_PROOF_ARTIFACT.
Write the proof artifact before parent Plan/Edit-Time/Truth gates and verify its exact digest.
Persist proof artifact and closed active plan together in the closure PR.
Bind proof artifact path/digest into the final parent close receipt.
Cover initial closure and PR_OPEN reprojection with deterministic artifact replacement.
out: No Plan Before Code projection bypass.
No mutation or widening of immutable source plan.
No modification of U01/U02/U03 material or close receipts.
No workflow, storefront, Builder, database or deployment change.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: The new artifact becomes part of the authority chain between final-main proof and persisted parent close receipt. It must create a real auditable planning surface without weakening generic critical-route semantics or allowing unbound evidence to authorize closure.

acceptanceCriteria: Proof artifact path is deterministic from parentTransactionId and remains identical across interruption/resume and safe-main reprojection.
Proof artifact JSON has an explicit versioned contract and deterministic content without timestamps or secrets.
Derived plannedFilePatterns includes active-plan metadata and the exact proof artifact path.
Derived semantic route declares mustCreate=[proofArtifactPath], proof includes proofArtifactPath, unknown=[], and authority exactly matches canonical derived expectedAuthorities.
Operational Intelligence accepts mustCreate-only route targeting only when parentClosureContext.contract is the canonical parent closure context contract.
A normal critical plan with empty mustEdit and arbitrary mustCreate remains invalid.
Plan Before Code projection for the derived closure plan is non-empty and yields the canonical parent closure domain, authority, subsystem, failure corpus and guard digest.
Edit-Time fails when the proof artifact is missing, has the wrong path, wrong contract, wrong parent id, wrong final main, wrong context digest or wrong byte digest.
Edit-Time passes the parent closure mustCreate obligation only when the executor-provided proof artifact exactly matches the derived plan context.
The closure commit contains both quality/development/active-plan.json and the deterministic proof artifact.
recordReleaseParentClosureWithProofContext rejects lifecycle plans whose artifact binding differs from the verified artifact.
Final parent close receipt records proofArtifactPath and proofArtifactDigest.
Safe-main reprojection updates the same artifact path to new deterministic content and requires new exact CI.
Immutable replay advances beyond #296's DEV_PLAN_PROJECTION_EMPTY/scope/route blocker family.
invariants: Parent closure proof artifact is evidence, not permission to mutate CLOSED child output.
Immutable source plan remains the completion-requirement authority.
Generic critical Operational Intelligence semantics remain unchanged outside valid parent closure context.
Artifact bytes are deterministic functions of already-authoritative parent/source/final-main inputs.
The artifact validated before Truth is exactly the artifact persisted by the closure PR.
Parent close receipt cannot reference an unpersisted or differently-digested artifact.

failureModes: Artifact path slug collision or nondeterministic naming.
Artifact is generated after Plan/Edit-Time instead of before them.
Artifact content contains mutable generatedAt timestamp.
Operational Intelligence parent closure exception accepts malformed parentClosureContext.
Derived route mustCreate path differs from generated artifact path.
Edit-Time environment points to another artifact than derived route.
Closure PR stages active-plan but omits artifact.
Safe-main reprojection leaves old artifact bytes on refreshed branch.
Lifecycle plan context and artifact context differ.
Final parent receipt stores artifact digest different from persisted file.
edgeCases: Exact last-child main closure with trustedMainAdvanceDigest=null.
Trusted main advance closure with non-null advance digest.
Interrupted retry finds same deterministic artifact path and identical bytes.
PR_OPEN safe-main reprojection rewrites same artifact path with new finalMain binding.
Artifact file exists but plan context was forged.
Arbitrary critical plan tries mustCreate-only route without parent closure context.
Parent closure route declares both accidental mustEdit and mustCreate targets.

alternatives.summary: Create and persist a deterministic quality/knowledge parent closure proof artifact as the real projected route target.
alternatives.reason: Provides a canonical DOMAIN-QUALITY proof surface and audit receipt without inventing runtime edits or bypassing planning gates.

alternatives.summary: Teach Plan Before Code to accept active-plan-only parent closure with empty projection.
alternatives.reason: Would create a special empty-projection path and weaken the requirement for a falsifiable execution target.

alternatives.summary: Declare an unchanged runtime file as mustEdit only to satisfy critical route validation.
alternatives.reason: Creates false implementation obligations and violates truthful planning.

alternatives.summary: Allow mustCreate to satisfy every critical plan's route target.
alternatives.reason: Broadens generic planning semantics beyond the narrowly justified parent closure case.

specialistReviews.finding: The previous closure-only plan had no real projected repository surface because active-plan is intentionally metadata-excluded.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use a deterministic executor-owned proof artifact under canonical quality knowledge ownership as the closure transaction surface.

specialistReviews.finding: A proof artifact is safe only if it cannot be forged or detached from exact parent/final-main state.
specialistReviews.resolution: Bind artifact to source-plan digest, completion contract, unit receipts, trusted-main proof and exact final main; validate before Truth and receipt recording.

specialistReviews.finding: The artifact verified in temporary proof must be byte-identical to the artifact persisted in the closure PR.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use deterministic content and digest, stage the exact file from the same temp worktree, and record its digest in the final receipt.

specialistReviews.finding: PR_OPEN reprojection must replace the same artifact rather than accumulating parallel evidence.
specialistReviews.resolution: Derive path only from parent transaction identity; final-main changes alter content/digest, not path.

specialistReviews.finding: #296 is deterministic and the previous historical-unplanned blocker is already removed.
specialistReviews.resolution: Regression must specifically prove non-empty projection and canonical closure scope while preserving #287 fix.

challenge.finding: Plan Before Code intentionally excludes it and projection remains empty.
challenge.resolution: Add a real proof artifact outside development metadata.

challenge.finding: Domain resolves but release-risk subsystem classification is absent, causing unresolved scope.
challenge.resolution: Use quality/knowledge/release-parent-closure-proofs path, which is canonical knowledge infrastructure.

challenge.scenario: Declare mustEdit on an unchanged runtime file.
challenge.finding: Edit-Time would encode a false implementation obligation.
challenge.resolution: Use mustCreate for the artifact and validate actual artifact evidence separately.

challenge.scenario: Globally count mustCreate for critical routes.
challenge.resolution: Count mustCreate only when parentClosureContext carries the canonical contract.

challenge.scenario: Artifact exists but is not persisted in closure PR.
challenge.finding: Final receipt would depend on ephemeral evidence.
challenge.resolution: Stage active-plan and proof artifact together and assert both in regression tests.

challenge.finding: Retry produces a different digest for identical authority state.
challenge.resolution: Artifact contract forbids mutable time fields and is built from deterministic authoritative inputs only.

challenge.scenario: Artifact path changes when final main changes.
challenge.finding: PR_OPEN reprojection could accumulate duplicate evidence files.
challenge.resolution: Path is parent-id-derived only; final-main changes replace content at the same path.

challenge.scenario: Edit-Time sees no committed diff at parent proof time.
challenge.finding: A plain mustCreate declaration alone would not prove the artifact exists.
challenge.resolution: Add explicit parent-closure artifact environment validation and count only exact validated artifact as fulfilled closure mustCreate evidence.

challenge.scenario: Lifecycle plan context matches but proof artifact digest was altered.
challenge.finding: Truth context alone cannot prove persisted artifact identity.
challenge.resolution: Bind artifact digest into context and revalidate in recordReleaseParentClosureWithProofContext.

challenge.scenario: An arbitrary plan injects parentClosureContext-shaped data to gain mustCreate routing.
challenge.resolution: Require exact canonical context contract plus proof-plan contract and regression-test malformed contexts as rejected.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only and require canonical Plan Before Code PASS before implementation.

Narrowly extend Operational Intelligence critical route target validation for canonical parent closure context mustCreate only, with negative tests for generic plans.
Add parent-closure artifact validation to Edit-Time using an explicit environment path; prove missing/forged/stale artifacts remain blocking.
Write the deterministic artifact in runParentProof before Plan/Edit-Time and pass the exact path through the proof environment.
Persist closed active-plan and exact proof artifact together in createClosurePullRequest, preserving existing force-with-lease and CI dispatch behavior.
Revalidate artifact binding before recordReleaseParentClosureWithProofContext and store path/digest in final close receipt.
Exercise exact-main, trusted-main and PR_OPEN reprojection paths, plus artifact tamper/missing/digest mismatch cases.
Require exact-head Quality, TypeScript, Production Build, Completion Truth and Lifecycle Closure PASS; then exact PR-head PASS and expected-head merge.
Require post-merge main CI SUCCESS on the merged hardening head before any immutable rehearsal replay.

Replay immutable source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65 and require the next Release Unit Execution to advance beyond #296's projection/scope/route blocker family; any different blocker remains fail-closed and returns through Failure Intake.

requirements.requirement: Parent closure must expose a real deterministic proof artifact that gives the derived closure plan a canonical projected target and binds final Truth/Lifecycle evidence to the exact persisted parent state.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A parent closure plan may not rely on active-plan metadata as its only projected surface.
MustCreate-only critical routing may not be enabled outside a valid canonical parent closure context.
A missing, stale, forged or differently-digested parent closure proof artifact may not satisfy Edit-Time or parent closure recording.
The parent close receipt may not rely on a proof artifact that is absent from the persisted closure commit.
